description: Use this when the user wants a word cloud, word art or tag cloud from text (survey answers, reviews, an article, notes) or from a list of words with weights, for example "make a word cloud of these comments". Takes text (up to 100,000 characters) or up to 500 word and weight pairs, plus max words (10 to 200), stop-word language (en, es, fr, de, it, pt or none), case rule, shape (rectangle or circle), orientation, colour set, font sizes and a seed. Returns the top words with counts, words left out and why, layout and PDF text checks, an interactive view, and SVG, PDF and CSV downloads. Does not read files or web pages, does not split Chinese, Japanese or Thai text into words, and does not stem or group words by meaning.

case.description: fold (default for text): Apple and apple count as one word, shown in lower case; as_written (default for a word list): case is kept and counted apart.

exclude_words.description: Extra words to leave out, up to 100, matched without case, e.g. ["project", "team"].

include_numbers.description: Count number-only words such as 2026 (default false).

max_font_size.description: Largest font size in points, up to 120 (default 64), at least min_font_size, e.g. 72.

max_words.description: Most words to draw, 10 to 200 (default 100), e.g. 50. The highest counts are drawn.

min_font_size.description: Smallest font size in points, 8 to 40 (default 10), e.g. 12.

min_length.description: Shortest word to count, in characters, 1 to 20 (default 2), e.g. 3.

orientation.description: horizontal (default): words read left to right; mixed: about a third of the words read bottom to top.

page_size.description: PDF page, landscape: letter (default) or a4.

palette.description: Colour set: classic (default), ocean (blues), forest (greens), sunset (reds and oranges) or mono (greys).

seed.description: Layout seed, 0 to 999999 (default 1). The same input and seed give the same layout; another seed gives another arrangement.

shape.description: rectangle (default, 720 x 520 pt) or circle (520 pt across).

stop_words.description: Stop-word list to remove common function words: en (default, English), es, fr, de, it, pt, or none to keep all words. Other languages keep all words, e.g. "es".

text.description: Text to turn into a cloud, up to 100,000 characters, e.g. survey answers. Give text or words, not both.

title.description: Optional title printed above the cloud and used in file names, up to 80 characters, e.g. "Customer feedback, Q3".

words.description: Alternative to text: up to 500 words with weights, e.g. [{"word":"growth","weight":12},{"word":"New York","weight":5}]. Each word up to 40 characters; weights above 0.

name: make_word_cloud
title: Make word cloud
